title: TESTS-003: Most compliance scripts save `WAS_CONNECTED` from `test_connection_battery()` and then ignore it, always disconnecting the target device at the end
description:
TESTS-003: Most compliance scripts save `WAS_CONNECTED` from `test_connection_battery()` and then ignore it, always disconnecting the target device at the end. Manual runs against already-connected hardware will leave devices disconnected and may disrupt an active setup. Restore the original connection state like `gps_compliance.sh` attempts to do, and fix the framework comment at `indigo_test_framework.sh:527` because the function returns original state, not final state. Next: revalidate historical evidence and assign a scoped repair task; no risk acceptance or closure is implied.

Imported from .factory/findings/archive/FND-000032.json (category: quality, blocking: no).
